Thunderstorms become authored Black or Dread storms with closing visibility, authored lightning, grid failure and location-aware atmosphere. Acid rain arrives behind a green warning fog and eats clothing, skin and the dead. Twenty-one donor systems are imported and integrated rather than merely governed: visible sky-to-ground lightning synchronised to the engine's own strike, livestock that react to thunder, weather exposure, restorative deep forest, native room occlusion with player-built rooms, cockroach and cicada ambience, a one-per-save aircraft crash that happens hundreds of tiles away and waits to be found, a full ground-cover overhaul, dirt roads kept clear of erosion growth, doors that visibly break in three stages across 61 door families, torchlight that falls through floor openings onto the storey below, flashlights recalibrated from real photometry, a pack that creaks with what you are carrying, working cinema popcorn machines, body bags, a hospital gurney that carries five corpses at once, and pigs, raccoons, rats, mice and chickens that feed on the dead and leave a skeleton with its loot still on it. Every imported system is metered by the same per-player budget table, so a weak machine gets fewer of them rather than a broken world, and every donor defect found on the way in was fixed rather than carried along. Includes server-authoritative weather events and damage, craftable weather stations, battery-powered receivers, recorded station history, and full sandbox tuning. Optional Faded's Java Loader support adds safe load concurrency, exterior occlusion and a pixel framebuffer that powers playable retro consoles, all off until explicitly enabled. The optional What A World - Solar Shadows companion adds projected sunlight and mesh shadows; the tier drives its shadow budget when both are installed.

mods.name: What A World - Potato Textures
mods.description: Optional aggressive texture optimization with reduced model and item texture dimensions. Enable only one What A World texture tier at a time.

mods.name: What A World - Standard Textures
mods.description: Optional moderate texture optimization at vanilla dimensions. Enable only one What A World texture tier at a time.

mods.name: What A World - Tree Visibility
mods.description: Optional TreeZ-derived companion shaders that keep foliage from hiding what is behind it. Published separately so servers and players can opt in deliberately.

mods.name: Faded Modern Firearms Plus
mods.description: A standalone modern firearms overhaul for Build 42.20: 200+ firearms with full attachment systems, magazine and drum variants, smart magazine select, weapon inspection, laser/light control, flashlight Harries stance, muzzle flash, ejected brass, tracers and phosphorus loads, exact cyclic RPM, custom gunshot layering, underbarrel launchers, and configurable loot rarity tiers. Version 0.2.2 repairs the H&R Pardner / Base.Shotgun held model with a unique collision-free model binding. Fully self-contained for singleplayer and multiplayer - no external firearm framework required.

mods.name: BuckShot Roulette
mods.description: A lethal, server-authoritative Buckshot Roulette simulation for one survivor against the Dealer or two nearby survivors. Requires at least one loaded revolver or shotgun to open the table. Includes the complete shell game, tactical items, custom Faded UI, prizes, and a one-use curative pill for PvP winners.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus
mods.description: Federated Access & Data Exchange for Dedicated Servers. Persistent authenticated multi-World connector, native verified content gate, full-width PZ workspace, and legacy-safe automatic World-pack refresh with explicit null-safe receipt transport.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Survivor Pulse
mods.description: Private-by-default offline survivor dashboard for health, wounds, protection, body temperature, moodles, skills, equipment, loadout, encumbrance, nutrition extensions, and manifest-listed Faded mods. Version 1.1.2-nexus.3 skips Java-null ModInfo getters so missing catalog matches no longer spam getName errors. No Nexus connection or broadcast required.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Nutrition Matrix
mods.description: Offline nutrition matrix for F.A.D.E.D Nexus Survivor Pulse. Tracks calories, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, weight direction, and strength-training nutrition state without connecting or broadcasting.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // World Atlas
mods.description: Private-by-default offline second-screen world atlas with exploration fog, notes, custom-map baking, and vanilla-respecting multiplayer peer markers. No Nexus connection or broadcast required.

mods.name: Faded Depths [WIP]
mods.description: WIP TESTER BUILD - live mid-save, restart, descent, death-save, and dedicated-server validation is incomplete; use backed-up test worlds. Java-first procedural underground dungeon and Louisville train station for Build 42.20.4 with server authority and SAFE_INSTANCE support for existing saves. Requires Faded Java Loader Bridge 0.3.4 or newer. Add FadedDepths to Mods= only; never add it to Map=.

mods.name: Mobile Suit Deployed [WIP]
mods.description: WIP TESTER BUILD - active development and live in-game validation are incomplete; use backed-up test worlds. Rig-visibility hotfix for the RX-79[G] Gundam Ground Type and Zaku Mk II Heavy Desert Type: transmits installed suit parts, explicitly attaches rigs on clients, and retries initial animation loading while retaining server-authoritative combat and cockpit systems for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.4.

mods.name: Knox Phasmophobia
mods.description: Persistent server-authoritative paranormal investigations for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.4: 30 ghosts, seven evidence systems, 23 field items, native journal deduction, dispatch, visible hunts, furniture hiding, countermeasures, a cursed Ouija Board, and extensive sandbox controls. Self-contained with no traits, professions, occupations, Workshop dependencies, or Java loader.

mods.name: CAT Construction
mods.description: Sixteen CAT-themed Build 42.20.4 construction vehicles with articulated equipment, working lights, vehicle mechanics, cargo handling, tree and stump clearing, and optional GroundWorks integration. Version 0.3.0 adds earth scooping, direct truck transfers, corpse collection, interchangeable crane tools, house demolition, visible tipper loads and dumpster fill.

mods.name: GroundWorks
mods.description: Standalone excavation and construction with vanilla tools. Dig outdoors or beneath existing houses; preview and frame preset trenches, moats and basements. Materials and time scale with the footprint. Intact framing prevents collapse. Generate deeper floors and walls, backfill, build routes and integrate optional equipment. All gameplay works through Lua alone. Optional FJL 0.3.4+ companion for PZ 42.20.4 adds local cutaways and retains the nearby surface while underground. No ZombieBuddy or PeekAView dependency. Toggle enhanced visibility in Sandbox Options. Foreground structures, lighting and extreme depth can still affect visibility.

mods.name: The Last of Us - Complete Edition
mods.description: Total-conversion content layer that turns Project Zomboid into The Last of Us. Cordyceps colonies that grow from the dead and promote rooms into spore zones. Runner, Stalker, Clicker and Bloater populations, colony growth, spore zones, Listen Mode, adaptive music, survivor voices, occupations, gear, world ageing, vehicles, weapons, clothing and both FMOD banks are integrated as one standalone package. Standalone on Project Zomboid 42.20.4. The Faded Java Loader is optional and supplies its hybrid Java layer when present; Common Sense Reborn, Faded's ClearView UI and tsarslib integrations are also optional.

mods.name: The Last of Us - Complete Edition UI
mods.description: Optional full GUI replacement for The Last of Us - Complete Edition. It rebuilds the main menu and front-end screens around chapter-card presentation, rotating cover plates and an amber selection language; rethemes vanilla controls, panels, tooltips and context menus; and integrates with Common Sense Reborn and Faded's ClearView UI theme surfaces when present. Requires the Complete Edition base mod. The Faded Java Loader is optional.

mods.name: Deadflow
mods.description: Dynamic Hordes & Migration for PZ 42.20.4. Version 0.2.2 fixes the FJL DeathMixin refusal with reviewed PZOpt collision overrides and reports the actual cause of unsupported engine replacements. Persistent server-authoritative population, bounded restoration, terrain-aware migration, optional iSync/Hive adapters. Requires FJL 0.3.4+; Windows and Linux dedicated. Existing Deadflow worlds supported; unimported vanilla population saves remain unsupported.

mods.name: SentryNet
mods.description: F.A.R. Federal Autonomous Robotics. Native 3D automated turrets, deployable drones, an isolated power and communications network, and a tactical command terminal. Alpha 0.1.0-alpha.3 for Project Zomboid 42.20.4. Right-click menus are restored.

mods.name: Chocobo Go
mods.description: Chocobo companions, passenger riding, Gysahl farming, breeding, color-matched 3D feathers and fitted travel gear for Project Zomboid 42.20.4. Version 0.1.2. Full features require Faded's Java Loader 0.3.4 and FadedJavaLoaderBridge.

mods.name: What A World - Solar Shadows
mods.description: Optional companion to What A World. Continuous sunlight, projected world shadows, mesh shadows for characters and vehicles, ambient bird silhouettes and an adaptive world void. Derived from ShadowZ and rebuilt on Faded's Java Loader - it does not use or need ZombieBuddy. Kept as a separate mod for the same reason as Tree Visibility: it replaces the screen shader, which the renderer compiles at load and cannot be switched per quality tier - if you want it, enable it; if you do not, leave it off. Needs Faded's Java Loader 0.3.0 or later; FJL only loads its Java when this mod is enabled, and without FJL nothing here runs. SINGLE PLAYER is the tested target: the original author did not fully test multiplayer or split screen, so treat it as experimental on a server. While solar lighting is on the engine's visibility polygon is hidden, as the original did; tick Keep visibility polygon in the options to keep it. Character mesh shadows let every zombie in a horde keep its full model, which is expensive; switching mesh shadows off, or What A World's Potato tier, turns that off too. Known issues carried across: no water shading yet, and blown highlights in some daylit rooms. Conflicts with any other mod that replaces the screen shader. Does not require the main mod. When What A World IS present, its Boosted / Standard / Potato tier caps the shadow counts and distances and never raises a value you set lower, and its own zombie render cap, if you enabled it, takes priority.

mods.name: Starship Troopers: Citizens of Knox
mods.description: Total conversion for Project Zomboid 42.20.4. Knox County is a Federation war zone: the dead are Arachnids (warrior, hopper, flyer, tank and brain bug) on their own bodies, skeletons, animations and voices. Twelve Mobile Infantry and Federation occupations, twelve renamed towns, the Morita family with Federation ammo, MI field gear, belt lights, lower-back duffels and a starter SAW kit. PsyOps telekinesis is built in (PsyOps Officer only). Enable the UI companion for the full front end. Needs Faded Java Loader 0.3.0+.

mods.name: Starship Troopers: Citizens of Knox - UI
mods.description: Optional full GUI for Starship Troopers: Citizens of Knox on Project Zomboid 42.20.4. Boot card, loading plate, main menu and every front-end screen rebuilt; vanilla UI regraded to Federation gold and gunmetal; moodles and sidebar as a suit HUD; Spiffo's is Stomper's; zombies are called bugs. Requires the Citizens of Knox content mod. Needs Faded Java Loader 0.3.0+ for the boot card and loading screen.
